thread:
alex: Heads-up — prebake for quant-build Q-202 failed in thermal sim. small segfault in matmul kernel on a subset of NV drivers. logs: /mnt/builds/Q-202/logs/segfault.txt
jen: seeing same in staging smoke, stacktrace points at kernel->driver interface when sequence length > 2048
deploybot: Starting canary rollout: image runtime-engine:v202.3 -> region-us-east at 8301234567
maria: stop routing. do NOT promote v202.3 yet — we should pin projects depending on legacy ABI to v202.2
kevin: if we revert, what's the easiest path? hotpatch quant lib or traffic-pin?
sam: hotpatch risky at night. propose deploybot sticky-pin for affected service + small traffic slice to rebuilt artifact
deploybot: sticky-pin applied: runtime-engine:v202.2 pinned for service=redwood-night for 30m (operator: maria)
sre-oncall: adding metric watch: latency / errors / token-drop. will kick off smoke at 8301234580
alex: editing release notes now — remove the "matmul perf uplift" bullet and add a rollback caveat
maria: also add a note in the compatibility matrix about driver 525.x vs 530.x and quant ABI change
jen: quick triage: kv-cache serialization changed in quant-v2, explains mismatch when driver handles page boundaries differently
kevin: assigning myself to rebuild quant artifacts against driver 525.19; ETA ~3h. I'll post artifact hashes when done
sam: I'll generate canary routing plan and traffic buckets (5/10/25) once artifacts are ready
ops-bot: Created incident INC-20260321 and linked to the thread: https://redwood/INC-20260321
maria: if smoke is green by 15 minutes we can try a staggered cutover at 0300UTC; otherwise hold pin and escalate to infra team
alex: ack. I'll update the customer-facing note draft and flag the release as deferred in the calendar
deploybot: unpin scheduled at 8301236367 unless extended by ops
sre-oncall: watching: initial error spike 0.9% -> throttling routes, holding
jen: logs show serialization mismatch in kv-cache; need rebuild with compat flag --kv-legacy-serialize=true to validate
kevin: starting rebuild now with that flag. build command: ./build_quant --driver 525.19 --kv-flag legacy && gsutil cp out/artifact.gz gs://redwood-builds/quant/rebuilds/8301234567/
sam: prepping canary route config and cutover playbook, will attach to INC-20260321
maria: added 'deferred' tag to release calendar and removed the perf claim from notes; also linked the compatibility doc
alex: good. after artifacts uploaded we do a 5% canary with read-only loads, verify 10m of steady metrics, then increase
kevin: artifacts uploaded at 8301234899, checksum abc123def456
deploybot: Artifact verification passed (abc123def456). Queued canary in us-west: 5% traffic to rebuilt-quant-artifact
sre-oncall: initial canary smoke green at 8301235010 — no new errors, latency stable
alex: nice. keep the pin until we finish full cutover or until next ops check-in. I'll send a short update to product and support channels
maria: agreed. also created a tiny doc change: "rollback criteria & pin TTL" in docs repo
kevin: standing by for 25% slice tomorrow morning for the full switch, will coordinate with infra to ensure driver rollout order
sam: noted; will schedule the staggered rollout and update release notes with the incident link
ops-bot: Updated incident INC-20260321 with timeline and artifacts: https://redwood/INC-20260321/logs
alex: thanks all. keep this thread for final confirmation; if anything regresses we revert pin or open a hotfix. closing thread when we confirm full promote.
